|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “USED: At the start of your activate phase, activate Force based on your opponent's icons instead of your own. LOST: Cancel Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[We're All Gonna Be A Lot Thinner! (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “USED: Play at the start of your activate phase. When you activate Force this turn, use your opponent’s Force icons instead of your own.<br />LOST: Cancel Into The Garbage Chute, Flyboy.” '''What changed:''' “At” → “Play at”; “phase,” → “phase. When you”; “based on” → “this turn, use”; “opponent's” → “opponent’s Force”; “own. LOST:” → “own.<br />LOST:”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards2.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 50. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[We're All Gonna Be A Lot Thinner!]].
* Later text: [[We're All Gonna Be A Lot Thinner! (V) (Virtual Set 2)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[We're All Gonna Be A Lot Thinner! (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[We're All Gonna Be A Lot Thinner!]].
